question: What is the primary objective of device "AroTrack", which was launched by IIT Bombay in December 2024?

options.text: To detect the moisture level in environment.
To monitor the air quality level.

solution:
The correct answer is __**To detect water pollutants**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The device "**AroTrack**" was launched by **IIT Bombay** in **December 2024** to address critical environmental concerns.
 
• The primary function of **AroTrack** is to **detect water pollutants**, helping in monitoring and analyzing water quality in real-time.
 
• The device utilizes **advanced sensors and IoT (Internet of Things)** technology to identify contaminants, such as heavy metals, chemicals, and organic pollutants, in various water bodies.
 
• AroTrack is designed to promote **sustainable water management** by providing actionable data to authorities, industries, and researchers to mitigate pollution.
 
• This initiative aligns with India’s commitment to achieving **clean water and sanitation** under the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDG-6)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Water Pollution in India:**

 
 
• India faces severe water pollution issues, with contaminants such as **industrial discharge, agricultural runoff, and untreated sewage** entering water bodies.
 
• According to the **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)**, over **70% of surface water** in India is unfit for consumption.
 
• Pollutants like **arsenic, lead, and nitrates** pose significant health risks, leading to diseases such as cholera, diarrhea, and cancer.
 
 
 
• **Technology Used in AroTrack:**
 
 
• The device employs **IoT-based sensors** to monitor physical, chemical, and biological parameters of water quality.
 
• It can detect pollutants such as **pH levels, turbidity, dissolved oxygen, and specific toxins** in real-time.
 
• Data collected by AroTrack is transmitted to a centralized server, allowing for **remote monitoring and analysis**.
 
 
 
• **Applications of AroTrack:**
 
 
• Useful for **municipalities** to ensure the supply of safe drinking water to households.
 
• Helps **industrial units** comply with **government pollution control norms**.
 
• Plays a vital role in **research and development** for developing new water treatment techniques.
 
 
 
• **Similar Initiatives in India:**
 
 
• The **Namami Gange Programme** aims to rejuvenate the Ganga river by reducing pollution and ensuring water quality.
 
• The **National Water Quality Monitoring Programme (NWQMP)** monitors water quality across India’s rivers and lakes.
 
• The **Jal Shakti Abhiyan** focuses on water conservation, rainwater harvesting, and cleaning of water bodies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Water Quality Monitoring:**

 
 
• Regular monitoring helps identify pollution sources and trends over time.
 
• It supports decision-making for effective water resource management and policy formulation.
 
• Ensures compliance with **national and international water quality standards**, such as those outlined by the **World Health Organization (WHO)**.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Water Pollution Control:**
 
 
• Lack of adequate infrastructure for **wastewater treatment**.
 
• High costs associated with implementing advanced monitoring systems like AroTrack.
 
• Need for greater public awareness and participation in reducing pollution at the source.
